name: table-pro
title: Grouped table
description: A Table whose rows open onto sub-rows and gather into groups with subtotals, with a pinned first column, a totals row and a compact density.

TableRowToggle.description: The chevron that opens a row: a tertiary xs icon Button with `aria-expanded`, pointing to the row's end when closed and down when open. Other props, `ref` included, go to the button.

props.name: name
props.description: The row it opens, for its name: "Rows under <name>".

props.name: getSubRows
props.description: A row's own rows, shown under it when it's open. Rows without any get no chevron.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Ids of the rows open at first (uncontrolled).

props.name: groupBy
props.description: Gathers the rows under a header row per value of this field.

props.name: groupOrder
props.description: Group values in the order to show them; groups left out follow, in the order of their first row.

props.name: renderGroup
props.description: Draws a group's name in its header (a Badge, say); the value as text by default.

props.name: collapsedGroups
props.description: Values of the closed groups (controlled). Groups are open unless listed.

props.name: defaultCollapsedGroups
props.description: Values of the groups closed at first (uncontrolled).

props.name: pinned
props.description: Keeps the first column (and the checkbox column) in place while the rest scroll sideways, with a shadow over them.

props.name: footer
props.description: Adds the totals row, in a `<tfoot>`: "Total", then each column's `aggregate` in its `format`.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Ids of the rows picked at first (uncontrolled).

props.name: renderCell
props.type: (cell: { row: R; column: TableGroupedColumn<R>; depth: number; content: React.ReactNode }) => React.ReactNode
props.description: Draws a body cell's content, after the column's own `cell`; the first column keeps the chevron and the indent in front of it. `depth` is 0 for a row you passed, 1 for its sub-rows.

props.name: renderRow
props.type: (row: { row: R; depth: number; selected: boolean; rowProps: React.ComponentProps<'tr'>; children: React.ReactNode }) => React.ReactNode
props.description: Draws each body row, as Table's `renderRow`: spread `rowProps` (focus, keys, ARIA and styles) on your `<tr>` and put `children` inside. Group header rows are drawn by the table.
